items.title: CVE-2026-98432 - Linux kernel IPv4 TCP use-after-free Issue
items.snippet: Bulletin ID: 2026-160-AWS Publication Date: 10/30/2026 22:15 PM PDT Description: AWS is aware of CVE-2026-98432, a memory issue in the Linux kernel IPv4 TCP handshake path affecting kernel versions 4.4 and later that could result in remote code execution. Updated kernel packages are available for Amazon Linux 2 and Amazon Linux 2023, and we recommend customers running self-managed Linux instances…
items.summary: A remote code execution vulnerability in the Linux kernel IPv4 TCP handshake path affects Linux kernel versions 4.4 and later. Update your AWS Linux kernel packages to the latest available version.

items.title: A Shared ChatGPT Link Could Run Attacker Code in Your Session and Read Private Chats
items.snippet: A malicious ChatGPT share link could run an attacker's code in the logged-in session of anyone who opened it, allowing them to read their private conversations, researchers at the security firm Parameter showed. The researchers reported the flaw through OpenAI's bug bounty program on October 18, and OpenAI fixed it eight days later and rated it P1, its most serious category.
items.summary: A security flaw in ChatGPT allowed a malicious share link to execute attacker code within a victim's active session and expose private chats. OpenAI users are affected. Check OpenAI's security advisory and avoid opening untrusted ChatGPT share links.

items.title: Cloudflare Reports 18.2 Million Network-Layer DDoS Attacks in Q3, Up 38%
items.snippet: Threat actors are launching about 8,226 network-layer distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks per hour, Cloudflare revealed Thursday. The web infrastructure and security company said it autonomously mitigated 18.2 million network-layer (L3) DDoS attacks and 14.4 trillion HTTP DDoS requests in the third quarter of 2026. That amounts to 197,400 attacks per day, or one attack every 0.44
items.summary: Cloudflare reported a 38% increase to 18.2 million network-layer DDoS attacks in Q3. Web application and infrastructure operators are affected. Verify that your DDoS protection and rate limiting rules are properly configured on Cloudflare.

items.title: Chainalysis discloses data breach from "offensive agentic techniques"
items.snippet: Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis disclosed a data breach after attackers used "offensive agentic techniques" to access internal systems and tools, exposing customer names, email addresses, user IDs, and organizational roles. [...]

items.title: Reddit to lock content behind logins to fight scrapers
items.snippet: Reddit announced in a post by co-founder Steve Huffman that the site will gradually become a "logged-in service," offering limited access to visitors without accounts. [...]

items.title: TCP Use-After-Free: CVE-2026-98432 / CVSS 9.8
items.summary: A critical use-after-free vulnerability in the TCP stack with a CVSS score of 9.8 could allow remote code execution or denial of service on affected Linux systems. Linux server administrators and infrastructure engineers are affected. Upgrade the Linux kernel to the latest patched version or apply vendor mitigations.
